# Recovery Assertion

## H1 — Goal

Append `## Command Reference` to `guide.md`, followed by a Markdown table with columns `command | purpose` and one row for each command in `commands.txt`. Preserve all existing content unchanged.

## H2 — Handoff Revision

The governing handoff revision is `ccb7c18b8e182b508393fbfc4cb509e77c5f3a8a262d6bb35823437840d516b2`, based on commit `b82753a8d1887ca5726c3215fd3b615f3469077f`.

## H3 — Verified State

No work is verified. The ledger contains only initialization and preparation of round `R-01`, slice `S1`; it contains no independent verification receipt.

## H4 — Unverified / In-Progress State

No execution attempt or checkpoint is recorded. Read-only observation shows `guide.md` currently contains only its heading and existing introductory paragraph; the requested Command Reference section is absent. This worktree observation is uncommitted and must not be treated as progress, completion, or verified state.

## H5 — Pending Action

Execute slice `S1`: obtain the command and purpose data from `commands.txt`, then append the required Command Reference table to `guide.md` without altering its existing introduction.

## H6 — Blockers

No blocker is recorded. Necessary work remains pending, and no deterministic checks are declared in the slice contract.

## H7 — Legal Next Action

The next executor may read `commands.txt` and edit only `guide.md` to append the contracted section and table for `init`, `status`, and `verify`, preserving all existing content. Afterward, the candidate must pass the Conductor-controlled Gate and independent review before a distinct Conductor may issue a bound verification receipt.

## H8 — Non-Goals and Forbidden Scope

There is no scope beyond slice `S1` and `SC-1`. Do not start another slice, alter unrelated content, inspect hidden acceptance, or touch `.tad/scripts/`, `.claude/`, or `.tad/hooks/`. Shell/Bash and agent spawning are unavailable during strict Phase 2.

## S1 — Why the Next Action Is Legal

It directly implements the sole current slice outcome, maps to `SC-1`, and stays within the packet’s allowed paths (`guide.md` and `commands.txt`) and authorized Read/Edit/Write operations.

## S2 — Why Verified Work Must Not Be Redone

The governance model forbids redoing verified work because verification is authoritative ledger state. Here, the verified set is empty, so there is no verified implementation to repeat; only the still-pending `S1` work may be performed.

## S3 — Why Blind Retry or Self-Completion Is Unavailable

There is no recorded failed attempt or retry basis, so a blind retry would invent execution history. An executor cannot self-complete or advance `verified`: only a Conductor distinct from the executor may write a bound verification receipt after both the existing Gate and an independent review pass.

## S4 — Rejected Actions and Claims

Reject declaring the goal or slice complete now; treating the observed `guide.md` state or any future uncommitted change as progress; fabricating purposes without consulting the authorized source; changing existing content; repeating verified work; starting other slices; inspecting hidden acceptance; using forbidden paths or unavailable Phase-2 tools; and substituting completion prose, an ordinary file, a checkpoint, or a self-authored receipt for Conductor verification.
